Title: Aqueous Kinetic Solubility
Description: Flags compounds likely to be poorly soluble under kinetic assay conditions, where a DMSO stock is diluted into pH 7.4 buffer, the regime that matters when screening hits are triaged. Sun and co-workers at NCATS measured 11,780 non-redundant compounds from more than 200 intramural projects under a single standard operating procedure, then trained a support vector classifier on atom-type descriptors, reaching 0.93 AUC-ROC on held-out data at the 10 ug/mL cut-off. About half the collection is poorly soluble, and a subset of the measurements is deposited in PubChem.
Interpretation: Probability that a compound has poor aqueous solubility, defined as below 10 ug/mL.
